question: Where is the nearest hospital along the direction of travel from Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden, Annville, PA to Main Street Inn, Boutique Hotel, Kutztown, PA?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Annville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Main Street Inn%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Kutztown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, d.geometry)) AS bearing FROM origin o, destination d ), hospitals_from_origin AS ( SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.geometry, degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry)) AS hospital_bearing, ST_Distance(o.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_from_origin FROM pois p, origin o WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' ) SELECT h.poi_name, h.addr_state, h.addr_city FROM hospitals_from_origin h, travel_azimuth ta WHERE -- Calculate the shortest absolute angular difference between the hospital's bearing from origin -- and the travel bearing, handling the 0/360 degree wrap-around. -- Filter for hospitals whose bearing is within +/- 45 degrees of the travel direction. LEAST( ABS(h.hospital_bearing - ta.bearing), 360 - ABS(h.hospital_bearing - ta.bearing) ) <= 45 ORDER BY h.distance_from_origin ASC LIMIT 1;
